status: specified after stage-one development and before any new validation/test outcomes
budget_amendment: Densify all methods equally at four-shot intervals over 12..96 after pilot, to avoid coarse-grid artifacts. No new test has been inspected.
exchange_transfer: All neural checkpoints remain trained on ZZ source data. No exchange source training, no checkpoint selection. All adapted priors use the same 64 labelled exchange calibration examples.
calibration: 20 disjoint groups of 64, five independent measurement repeats each; 64-shot labels from zz_known allocation for ZZ and fixed allocation for exchange
validation_selection: For each target 0.065 and 0.053 select minimum-shot candidate whose validation selection score is <= target; ties: lower offline cost then score. The selection score is mean MAE plus 1.645 times a conservative sum-of-variance-components standard error across query means, calibration-group means, and checkpoint means. It is a selection guardrail, not a reported confidence interval.
baseline_candidates: DFE fixed, pilot and (ZZ only) zz_known; compare all at identical budget grid
controls: all six prior classes, raw and adapted, and both fusion types; same-budget 32-shot neural versus ridge is prespecified secondary
selection_storage: Write selection JSON with validation hash before starting test evaluation; test evaluator rejects unselected configurations
test_intervals: 2000 paired crossed/hierarchical bootstrap samples; preserve shared measurements across checkpoints; no budget tuning on test
multiplicity_amendment: Use Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided bounds (97.5th percentile per contrast for two targets), conservative relative to the originally planned Holm procedure. Equivalence requires the 95% interval to lie within +/-0.002. Never equate noninferiority with equivalence.
target_confirmation: Report test MAE and intervals separately from difference intervals. Call common target certified only if upper 95% one-sided MAE bounds for both estimators are <= target; otherwise report the shortfall without choosing replacement budgets.
break_even: Report for fixed validation-selected shot budgets only when accuracy criterion and positive shot difference hold; no confidence interval on a deterministic cost quotient. Uncertainty in accuracy validity is reported separately.
cost_scope: Deployment measurement shots and per-deployment finite-label calibration/pilots only. Research validation sweeps, source synthetic labels, input Choi acquisition and classical compute are separate excluded costs.
label_noise: Independent label and fusion-fit measurements; out-of-fold priors for fusion fitting; EB residual variance subtracts observed finite-label variance
grid: Same parameter seeds and sample counts as archived audits; nested grids 15/29/57/113 and separate 128-point quadrature for explicitly approximate continuous risk
